vacuum_policy: cleaning=start; idle=return_to_base/stop fallback; capability-gated; physical experiments blocked
manual_feedback: Wrong decision keeps the existing immediate Live correction path and also advances the isolated Candidate feedback revision. Historical Teach remains supervised RL evidence and also advances that Candidate.
manual_feedback_ui: Four Live actions remain Shadow/Control, Wrong decision, Settings, Teach. Candidate generations have a separate card with Promote and Discard.
manual_feedback_context: Wrong decision keeps its existing context-learning behavior. Candidate rebuilds independently consume durable Wrong-decision and Teach evidence.
manual_feedback_schema: Teach RL can replace occupied context slots when a supervised hidden feature is stronger; the resulting rebuild is isolated in Candidate until future comparison and explicit Promote.
manual_feedback_safety: Wrong decision and Executor guards are unchanged. Teach stores historical training data and Candidate inference never sends a device service directly.
desired_teaching: Historical Teach points are persistent supervised RL examples; they do not provide a runtime override or immediate device action.
agent_rendering: event-time renderer dispatch; stable card ownership by normalized agent ID; Candidate generation uses a distinct secondary card preserved across Live-card reconciliation
button_teaching: Dedicated Teach RL label log, bounded Recorder context refresh, full-context candidate scoring, isolated offline Candidate rebuild and supervised LinUCB fine-tuning; Wrong decision remains on the legacy teaching endpoint.
live_ui: Independent 500 ms lightweight non-overlapping polling; Candidate diagnostics poll separately without card flicker
teaching_history: Teach chart uses recorded effective runtime Desired from decision_history, matching the last_prediction shown on the agent card. Current-policy replay is not presented as historical Desired; missing or stale runtime records render as gaps.
teach_desired_history: effective post-teaching/post-experiment runtime Desired; 95-second freshness; pending in-memory decision records are included before SQLite flush
teach_rl: labels -> Candidate -> bounded Recorder context -> feature reselection -> deterministic rebuild -> supervised LinUCB -> paired future comparison
teach_rl_feature_reselection: full eligible context after Recorder refresh; strong supervised features can replace occupied context slots inside Candidate
teach_rl_queue: context preflight and Candidate rebuild use the shared heavy-job gate; Live remains available while the hidden surrogate trains
wrong_decision: immediate Live contextual/manual correction plus isolated Candidate feedback revision
sensor_tournament: persistent candidate-pool -> context challenger -> future-only prequential validation -> promotion -> probation/rollback
sensor_tournament_promotion: 40+ future samples, 3+ observed days, >=3pp cumulative gain, three consecutive 24h winning windows, 24h cooldown
sensor_tournament_primary_protection: primary replacement requires >7pp gain unless global margin is stricter
sensor_tournament_quality: predictive gain is reliability-adjusted; unavailable sensors are penalized
sensor_tournament_requalification: schema promotion demotes affected Control agent to Shadow and requires fresh qualification
sensor_tournament_probation: previous serialized model/schema preserved; >3pp degradation after minimum paired evidence rolls back automatically
sensor_tournament_simulator: A: new 90% sensor beats 75% champion and promotes; B: 300 tiny-sample noise sensors cannot promote; C: concept drift automatically replaces A with B
fast_light_baseline: current enabled Home Assistant automation first; extra raw sensors enter through Sensor Tournament
fast_light_objective: automation-residual timing in Shadow: confirmed earlier ON and safe earlier OFF are rewarded
fast_light_negative_outcomes: false early ON, premature OFF, false early OFF and quick OFF-to-ON retrigger are penalized
fast_light_tournament_metric: paired normalized timing utility for fast binary power agents; balanced accuracy retained as safety guardrail
fast_light_tournament_safety: block promotion above 10% challenger timing failures or >3pp balanced-accuracy degradation
fast_light_timing_persistence: additive fast_light_timing_metrics table; no existing user tables cleared
agent_candidate_lifecycle: Live -> isolated hidden Candidate rebuild -> paired future A/B -> explicit Promote -> new Live generation in Shadow
agent_candidate_trigger: Wrong decision and Teach edits advance feedback revision; Build Candidate now and Rebuild request a build without fabricating feedback
agent_candidate_isolation: Candidate surrogate is hidden from normal Store agent enumeration and never enters ActionIntent/Executor service dispatch
agent_candidate_coalescing: 15-second feedback debounce plus one running Candidate and durable feedback revision; genuine feedback during build forces a newer rebuild before promotion
agent_candidate_feedback_conflicts: latest explicit instruction wins for the same historical instant before Candidate training
agent_candidate_config_guard: Live policy config edits invalidate paired evidence; Candidate syncs to current Live config before rebuild and Promote requires an exact current config match
agent_candidate_comparison: same-future-outcome Live-vs-Candidate accuracy plus ON/OFF timing, false-early diagnostics and paired wins
agent_candidate_binary_gate: at least 40 future outcomes with at least 20 ON and 20 OFF; Candidate may not regress accuracy by more than 3pp
agent_candidate_promotion: stable logical agent ID; Control lease is released first; promoted generation is persisted in Shadow before inference wake; Candidate surrogate is deleted
agent_candidate_discard: discard intent survives restart and completes without another rebuild or a usable Candidate model
agent_candidate_rollback: previous Live generation is retained only as a hidden 24h model snapshot
migration: additive SQLite only; Live agents, archive history, Teach labels, feedback, models, benchmarks, decision history and Tournament state are preserved
anticipation_simulator: Production anticipation, dispatch and reward simulator remains mandatory
fast_light_timing_simulator: automation-relative ON lead/OFF saved-time rewards plus false/premature penalties remain mandatory
